literal: Twelfth month, on bingyin day supreme commander King of Qin-Jin Chun encountered Jurchen troops; they fought at Jili Mountain and were defeated.
idiomatic: On bingyin day of the twelfth month supreme commander King of Qin-Jin Chun encountered Jurchen troops; they fought at Jili Mountain and were defeated.

literal: The Jurchen again seized prefectures and counties near Xian Prefecture.
idiomatic: The Jurchen again seized prefectures and counties near Xian Prefecture.

literal: On gengwu day an edict blamed himself.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the court issued an edict of self-reproach.

literal: On guiyou day yilübi Zhala and Da Gongding were sent through all circuits to recruit troops.
idiomatic: On guiyou day yilübi Zhala and Da Gongding were sent through all circuits to recruit troops.

literal: On dingchou day Western Capital regent Xiao Yixue was made Northern Court chancellor; Northeast Route field commander Xi Xiamo administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Western Capital regent Xiao Yixue was made Northern Court chancellor; Northeast Route field commander Xi Xiamo administered Xi Six Divisions great king affairs.

literal: That year Jurchen Aguda, using Iron Prefecture Yang Pu's plan, assumed the imperial dignity, established the era Tianfu, and styled the state Jin.
idiomatic: That year Jurchen Aguda, using Iron Prefecture Yang Pu's plan, assumed the imperial dignity, established the era Tianfu, and styled the state Jin.

literal: Yang Pu also said that since antiquity heroes founding states or receiving abdication always first sought investiture from a great state; envoys were therefore sent to discuss peace and seek investiture.
idiomatic: Yang Pu also said that since antiquity heroes founding states or receiving abdication always first sought investiture from a great state; envoys were therefore sent to discuss peace and seek investiture.

literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, went to Duck Marsh.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, in the first spring month the court went to Duck Marsh.

literal: On dinghai day Yelü Nuge and others were sent as envoys to Jin to discuss peace.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Yelü Nuge and others were sent as envoys to Jin to discuss peace.

literal: On gengyin day Baoding Army military commissioner Zhang Chong surrendered Shuang Prefecture's two hundred households to Jin.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Baoding Army military commissioner Zhang Chong surrendered Shuang Prefecture's two hundred households to Jin.

literal: Eastern Route prefectures and counties saw bandits rise like bees; they plundered the people and took them along for food.
idiomatic: Eastern Route prefectures and counties saw bandits rise like bees; they plundered the people and took them along for food.

literal: Second month, Yelü Nuge returned from Jin; the Jin sovereign replied in a letter: "If you treat me as elder brother, yearly tribute of local products, return my Supreme, Central, and Xingzhongfu three-circuit prefectures and counties;
idiomatic: Second month, Yelü Nuge returned from Jin; the Jin sovereign replied in a letter: "If you treat me as elder brother, yearly tribute of local products, return my Supreme, Central, and Xingzhongfu three-circuit prefectures and counties;

literal: send imperial princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and great ministers' sons and grandsons as hostages;
idiomatic: send imperial princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and great ministers' sons and grandsons as hostages;

literal: return my envoys and the original tallies and tokens, and Song, Xia, Goryeo correspondence, edicts, and memorials — then the agreement may stand."
idiomatic: return my envoys and the original tallies and tokens, and Song, Xia, Goryeo correspondence, edicts, and memorials — then the agreement may stand."

literal: Third month, on jiawu day Nuge was again sent as envoy to Jin.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the third month Nuge was again sent as envoy to Jin.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinyou day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On xinyou day of the fourth summer month Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

literal: Fifth month, on renwu new moon, Nuge brought a letter agreeing not to expect a reply this month.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the fifth month Nuge brought a letter agreeing not to expect a reply this month.

literal: On wuxu day Nuge was again sent as envoy to Jin, insisting on the middle course of discussion.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Nuge was again sent as envoy to Jin, insisting on the middle course of discussion.

literal: That month arrived at Nage Marsh.
idiomatic: That month the court arrived at Nage Marsh.

literal: Bandits An Sheng'er and Zhang Gao'er gathered two hundred thousand; Yelü Mage and others beheaded Sheng'er at Longhua Prefecture; Gao'er fled into Yi Prefecture and joined Huo Liuge.
idiomatic: Bandits An Sheng'er and Zhang Gao'er gathered two hundred thousand; Yelü Mage and others beheaded Sheng'er at Longhua Prefecture; Gao'er fled into Yi Prefecture and joined Huo Liuge.

literal: The Jin sovereign sent Hu Tugun with Nuge bearing a letter, reporting as in the former agreement.
idiomatic: The Jin sovereign sent Hu Tugun with Nuge bearing a letter, reporting as in the former agreement.

literal: Sixth month, on dingmao day Nuge and others were sent bearing Song, Xia, and Goryeo books, edicts, and memorials to Jin.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the sixth month Nuge and others were sent bearing Song, Xia, and Goryeo books, edicts, and memorials to Jin.

literal: Huo Liuge captured Haibei Prefecture and hastened toward Yi Prefecture; army commander Huili Bao and others defeated him.
idiomatic: Huo Liuge captured Haibei Prefecture and hastened toward Yi Prefecture; army commander Huili Bao and others defeated him.

literal: More than eight hundred households of the people of Tong, Qi, Shuang, and Liao four prefectures surrendered to Jin.
idiomatic: More than eight hundred households of the people of Tong, Qi, Shuang, and Liao four prefectures surrendered to Jin.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted at Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Autumn Mountain.

literal: Jin again sent Hu Tugun, waiving hostages and Supreme Capital and Xingzhongfu subordinate prefectures and counties, trimming the yearly tribute: "If you treat me as elder brother and investiture uses Han ritual, the agreement may stand."
idiomatic: Jin again sent Hu Tugun, waiving hostages and Supreme Capital and Xingzhongfu subordinate prefectures and counties, trimming the yearly tribute: "If you treat me as elder brother and investiture uses Han ritual, the agreement may stand."

literal: Eighth month, on gengwu day Nuge and Tujie were sent as envoys to Jin to discuss investiture ritual.
idiomatic: On gengwu day of the eighth month Nuge and Tujie were sent as envoys to Jin to discuss investiture ritual.

literal: Ninth month, Tujie was detained; Nuge was sent back and told him: "If your words are not obeyed, do not send envoys again."
idiomatic: In the ninth month Tujie was detained; Nuge was sent back and told him: "If your words are not obeyed, do not send envoys again."

literal: Intercalary month, on bingyin day Nuge was again sent as envoy to Jin; Xiao Bao, Yeli, and fifteen others each led households in surrender to Jin.
idiomatic: On bingyin day of the intercalary month Nuge was again sent as envoy to Jin; Xiao Bao, Yeli, and fifteen others each led households in surrender to Jin.

literal: Winter, tenth month, Nuge and Tujie brought Jin's letter.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Nuge and Tujie brought Jin's letter.

literal: Zhang Yinggu of Longhua Prefecture and four others led the masses in surrender to Jin.
idiomatic: Zhang Yinggu of Longhua Prefecture and four others led the masses in surrender to Jin.

literal: Eleventh month, deputy supreme commander Xiao Tabuye died.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month deputy supreme commander Xiao Tabuye died.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiashen day investiture ritual was fixed; Nuge was sent as envoy to Jin.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the twelfth month investiture ritual was fixed; Nuge was sent as envoy to Jin.

literal: Ningchang Army military commissioner Liu Hong surrendered Yi Prefecture's three thousand households to Jin.
idiomatic: Ningchang Army military commissioner Liu Hong surrendered Yi Prefecture's three thousand households to Jin.

literal: At that time south-of-the-mountains circuits had great famine; Qian, Xian, Yi, Jin, Xingzhong, and other routes — a dou of grain cost several bolts of silk; the people ate elm bark; afterward they ate one another.
idiomatic: At that time south-of-the-mountains circuits had great famine; Qian, Xian, Yi, Jin, Xingzhong, and other routes — a dou of grain cost several bolts of silk; the people ate elm bark; afterward they ate one another.

literal: That year one hundred three jinshi including Wang were released.
idiomatic: That year one hundred three jinshi including Wang were released.

literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, Jin sent Wulin Da Zanmo bearing a letter to welcome investiture.
idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first spring month, Jin sent Wulin Da Zanmo bearing a letter to welcome investiture.

literal: Second month, went to Duck Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Duck Marsh.

literal: Bandit Zhang Sabo induced Central Capital grain-shooting troops to usurp title; Southern Route army commander Yudu captured Sabo.
idiomatic: Bandit Zhang Sabo induced Central Capital grain-shooting troops to usurp title; Southern Route army commander Yudu captured Sabo.

literal: Third month, on dingwei new moon, administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Xini Lie and others invested the Jin sovereign as emperor of Eastern Huai State.
idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the third month administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Xini Lie and others invested the Jin sovereign as emperor of Eastern Huai State.

literal: On jiyou day Wulin Da Zanmo, Nuge, and others first reported by letter.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Wulin Da Zanmo, Nuge, and others first reported by letter.

literal: Summer, fifth month, Zubu Busuzhi and others rebelled, seized pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo, and inspector Xiao Xieli died.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month Zubu Busuzhi and others rebelled, seized pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo, and inspector Xiao Xieli died.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted at Southern Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Southern Mountain.

literal: Jin again sent Wulin Da Zanmo, reproaching that the investiture text lacked "treat as elder brother," did not say "Great Jin" but said "Eastern Huai" — the meaning of a small state cherishing virtue;
idiomatic: Jin again sent Wulin Da Zanmo, reproaching that the investiture text lacked "treat as elder brother," did not say "Great Jin" but said "Eastern Huai" — the meaning of a small state cherishing virtue;

literal: and that the investiture text had the two characters "qu cai," language involving light insult;
idiomatic: and that the investiture text had the two characters "qu cai," language involving light insult;

literal: and phrases such as "Yaofen Duozhan" were all ill-intended and greatly at odds with proper form.
idiomatic: and phrases such as "Yaofen Duozhan" were all ill-intended and greatly at odds with proper form.

literal: Only if according to the former letter's stipulations would they comply.
idiomatic: Only if according to the former letter's stipulations would they comply.

literal: Yang Xunqing and Luo Ziwei led the masses in surrender to Jin.
idiomatic: Yang Xunqing and Luo Ziwei led the masses in surrender to Jin.

literal: Eighth month, Prince of Zhao Xini Lie was made Western Capital regent.
idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince of Zhao Xini Lie was made Western Capital regent.

literal: Ninth month, arrived at Western Capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court arrived at Western Capital.

literal: Again sent Xini Lie and Yang Li Zhong first bearing the investiture draft as envoys to Jin.
idiomatic: Again Xini Lie and Yang Li Zhong were sent first bearing the investiture draft as envoys to Jin.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiaxu new moon, Yelü Chen Tunu and more than twenty others plotted rebellion and were executed.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the tenth winter month Yelü Chen Tunu and more than twenty others plotted rebellion and were executed.

literal: That month envoys were sent returning Wulin Da Zanmo bearing the letter.
idiomatic: That month envoys were sent returning Wulin Da Zanmo bearing the letter.

literal: Tenth year, spring, second month, went to Duck Marsh.
idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the second spring month the court went to Duck Marsh.

literal: Jin again sent Wulin Da Zanmo bearing a letter and a copy of the investiture text, still demanding troops from Goryeo.
idiomatic: Jin again sent Wulin Da Zanmo bearing a letter and a copy of the investiture text, still demanding troops from Goryeo.

literal: Third month, on jiyou day among the people those with herds of horses — one in ten was taken to supply the Eastern Route army.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the third month among the people those with herds of horses — one in ten was taken to supply the Eastern Route army.

literal: On gengshen day because the Jin had fixed the two characters "Dasheng," the same as a former dynastic title, Xini Lie was again sent to discuss.
idiomatic: On gengshen day because the Jin had fixed the two characters "Dasheng," the same as a former dynastic title, Xini Lie was again sent to discuss.

literal: The Jin sovereign was angry and thereupon broke relations.
idiomatic: The Jin sovereign was angry and thereupon broke relations.

literal: Summer, fourth month, hunted at Hutou White Mountain; hearing Jin troops were again raised, Yelü Baisi and others selected three thousand elite troops to reinforce the Liao army.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court hunted at Hutou White Mountain; hearing Jin troops were again raised, Yelü Baisi and others selected three thousand elite troops to reinforce the Liao army.

literal: Fifth month, the Jin sovereign personally attacked the Supreme Capital, captured the outer wall; regent Tabuye led the masses out to surrender.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the Jin sovereign personally attacked the Supreme Capital, captured the outer wall; regent Tabuye led the masses out to surrender.

literal: Sixth month, on yiyou day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Yixue was made Supreme Capital regent, administering Salt-Iron Inner Court two offices and Northeast field army commissioner affairs.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the sixth month Northern Court chancellor Xiao Yixue was made Supreme Capital regent, administering Salt-Iron Inner Court two offices and Northeast field army commissioner affairs.

literal: Autumn, hunted at Sha Ridge.
idiomatic: In autumn the court hunted at Sha Ridge.

literal: Winter, again arrived at Western Capital.
idiomatic: In winter the court again arrived at Western Capital.

idiomatic: Collation Notes

idiomatic: 1: Aguda sent Saisi with a reply — Saisi also appears in the ninth month of this year.

idiomatic: Dependent States table both read Saici.

idiomatic: 2: Yelü Zhangnu to Yelü Zhangnu — Per the note Yelü Zhangnu and Yelü Zhangnu are the same person; Jin History reads Zhangnu.

idiomatic: Annals events are duplicated.
